claim.purpose: Implement the independent Runtime v3 fast validation lane

initial.title: [runtime-v3][ci] Give Runtime v3 an independent fast validation lane
initial.goal: Make Runtime v3 path changes select a small, independent, reliable CI validation lane.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime v3-only diffs run only the v3 lane; mixed diffs retain required legacy validation; unmapped v3 paths fail closed.
authority_boundary: Path-policy selection is authoritative for lane selection
Runtime v3 proof commands remain explicit argv and Rust-owned where possible
initial.task_boundary: Add and prove the Runtime v3 fast path-policy profile without redesigning the entire CI topology.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime v3-only paths select only the independent v3 lane
Mixed Runtime v3 plus legacy paths select both required profiles
Focused proof runs quickly and does not invoke unrelated broad jobs
initial.plan_summary: Inspect current selector, add explicit v3 profile and focused command mapping, add contract fixtures, then validate the three path classes.

steps.action: Map current path-policy and fast-lane behavior
Implement Runtime v3 profile and fixtures
Run focused selector and CI contract validation

invariants: No unmapped Runtime v3 path silently falls back to broad legacy validation
Mixed diffs never lose required legacy validation
The v3 lane uses explicit bounded commands
risks: Existing selector assumptions may classify runtime-v3 paths too broadly
Observatory proof may require Python validation as a declared external proof command
stop_conditions: Selector behavior is proven for all three path classes
Subagent review has no actionable findings

validation_lanes.proof_role: selector and focused Runtime v3 validation

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on unmapped Runtime v3 paths or missing focused proof commands; preserve legacy lanes for mixed diffs.
review_prompts: Does the selector fail closed for unmapped v3 paths?
Does a mixed diff retain legacy validation?
Is the v3 lane independent and bounded?
Are the fixtures deterministic and fast?
